title: The Form Maker by 10Web WordPress plugin before 1.15.51 does not consistently escape user-submitted field values…
description: The Form Maker by 10Web WordPress plugin versions before 1.15.51 improperly handle user-submitted field values by not consistently escaping them before rendering on the submissions admin page. This flaw allows unauthenticated users to store payloads that execute arbitrary web scripts in the session of an administrator who views the submissions.
